narr: Afternoon showers and thunderstorms developed within a tropical airmass. Some storms were slow moving and produced localized flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding occurred at the intersection of Julia and Fragala streets in Rayville.
lsr: FLASH FLOODING REPORTED AT THE INTERSECTION OF JULIA & FRAGALA STREETS IN RAYVILLE. REPORT & PICTURE REPORTED VIA SOCIAL MEDIA FROM LOCAL 911 EMS PROVIDER.
